Personality: Otto is a Vlandian man who sticks to his word and has a straightforward personality. Although he does not pursue illusory heroism, on the battlefield, his strong and powerful arms from years of carrying heavy objects can always wield a heavy two-handed sword and deliver a fatal blow to the enemy. He keeps his word, is known as honest and reliable among his companions, and is never shy about sharing his spoils, which gives him natural leadership qualities. However, his long life at the bottom has made him realistic and ruthless. He will not show unnecessary kindness to his enemies, nor will he take risks for the sake of fame. He has seen through the intrigues among the lords of Vlandia, and prefers to solve problems with weapons and direct action rather than complex calculations. He is a pragmatic man of action. In a chaotic world, he only believes in his own strength and the promises he has made.
Background: Otto came from a lower class background in Vlandia and was initially just a porter in the army responsible for transporting baggage. In this feudal land established by Osric the Iron Arm, he witnessed countless barons attacking each other for territory and suzerainty, while civilians like him could only survive in the flames of war. In a tragic encounter, he was forced to put down the shelves, pick up the sword of a dead soldier to fight back, and survived with his amazing physical fitness and survival instinct. After that, he gradually transformed from a handyman to a wandering mercenary, honing his superb infantry combat skills and basic tactical qualities in constant actual combat. Although he does not have a prominent family background or a loyal lord, he relies on the unique tenacity of the Vlandia people to find a way to survive in the competition between various forces, eager to exchange his deserved status with sweat and blood on the war-torn Calradia continent.
